newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ANALYSTS' COMMENTS ON PHILIPS Q2 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS' COMMENTS ON PHILIPS Q2 RESULTS.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV on Thursday reported second quarter net profits from ordinary operations rose to 693 million guilders from 304 million.
Total net profit jumped to 747 million guilders from a loss of 456 million in the same period of 1996.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results:

"The results are much better than expected and what is surprising is the enormous improvement in Europe. The loss in the United States was to be expected. We will increase our earnings estimates for the company."
